items.title: Judge declines to dismiss Suno publicity rights case, as sixteen more musicians join the legal battle
items.summary: Earlier this week the Suno lawsuit that accuses the AI company of infringing the publicity rights of artists, instead of copyright, was expanded, with sixteen new musicians added as plaintiffs in an amended complaint. The judge has now also denied Suno’s motion to dismiss the original lawsuit

items.title: Eminem Publisher Eight Mile Style Files Amended Suno Copyright and DMCA Suit, Adding 100+ Allegedly Infringing Outputs — ‘Lose Yourself,’ ‘Without Me,’ and More
items.summary: Suno is facing yet another expanded copyright infringement lawsuit – this time from Eminem publisher Eight Mile Style, which has joined Elvis Presley Enterprises, Reservoir, and others in bolstering its high-stakes claims. Eight Mile made the amended action official yesterday, less than two weeks after initially suing…

items.title: Total Hypocrisy? Disney Sued Over Multiple Instances of Alleged Copyright Infringement on Social Media
items.summary: LAA Music sues Disney over three copyrighted songs allegedly used across seven promotional social media clips for EPSN, Hulu, FX, and Disney Parks. On Tuesday, November 24, NFL agent Zac Hiller and his publishing company, LAA Music, filed a federal lawsuit against The Walt Disney Co., which was then shared with Digital…

items.title: Eminem’s Publishers Add 108 Alleged AI Tracks to Suno Copyright Lawsuit
Federal Judge Rejects Dismissal Motion in Warner Music v. Designer Shoe Warehouse — As a Subpoena Sub-Dispute Boils Over
items.summary: A federal judge has officially rejected Designer Shoe Warehouse’s push to dismiss a substantial portion of Warner Music’s social-media-focused copyright infringement lawsuit. DSW parent Designer Brands quietly submitted that dismissal motion back in May, after a number of Warner Music Group (WMG) subsidiaries fired off…

items.title: Australia’s AI and copyright debate heats up after new report
items.summary: Tensions continue to rise in Australia around how the country’s government plans to balance AI and copyright. This week, the Australian parliament’s Joint Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence published a report including some recommendations. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Aussie MPs’ new AI proposals “disguise” pro-big tech copyright reforms as “a favour to creators”, says ARIA boss
items.summary: Australian MPs have published a report on AI, which talks about the need to protect creators and rightsholders, but also proposes significant copyright reforms to provide “the certainty necessary” for AI companies. The music industry says no such reforms are required, accusing MPs of “gaslighting”

items.title: More plaintiffs have joined artists’ class-action Suno lawsuit
items.summary: The Chicks, Carl Craig and Ezra Furman sounds like an unlikely musical collaboration. But no, this isn’t the latest track popping out of the Grand Theft Auto VI soundtrack. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: DistroKid Hands Over AI Music Data in Suno Copyright Lawsuit
ElevenLabs in early talks to raise at $33B valuation – more than six times that of AI music rival Suno (report)
items.summary: ElevenLabs’ annual recurring revenue has reportedly hit USD $700 million, up from $600 million in September. Source

items.title: Tidal veta la música generada con IA al 100 %
items.summary: Tidal rechazará y retirará desde el 9 de diciembre toda la música generada íntegramente con IA. Según la compañía, el 43 % de lo que le llegó en 90 días lo era, y su responsable en Block habla de borrar 29 millones de canciones.

items.title: Music may be excluded from Australia’s AI-friendly copyright reforms - though ARIA says “we stand with the rest of the creative and media industries”
items.summary: This week the creative and media industries came together to oppose AI-friendly copyright reforms being considered by the Australian government. It’s now being reported that those reforms might not actually impact on music, though the music industry says it remains committed to the wider campaign

tip.title: Registra tu catálogo también en la sociedad de gestión
tip.body: El registro de autoría y la recaudación son trámites distintos. Si tu obra no está dada de alta en la sociedad correspondiente, las regalías de ejecución pública simplemente no te llegan.

tip.title: Register with your collecting society too
tip.body: Copyright registration and royalty collection are separate steps. If your work isn't registered with the right society, public performance royalties simply never reach you.
